faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by North Eastern Indira Gandhi Regional Institute of Health & Medical Scienes (NEIGRIHMS) for an ICMR funded project in Shillong, Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Staff Nurse- Project Nurse under the research field on a contract basis, offering candidates an opportunity to work in a medical research environment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Staff Nurse- Project Nurse position in North Eastern Indira Gandhi Regional Institute of Health & Medical Scienes.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application form for the NEIGRIHMS Project Staff Nurse- Project Nurse recruitment is 25-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) Course along with a good command of Khasi and English in speaking, reading, and writing.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Staff Nurse- Project Nurse post is 28 years as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Staff Nurse- Project Nurse post will receive a salary of Rs. 20000/- per month plus HRA at the rate of 10%.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their application summary in the Google form, send the complete application in PDF format via email, and ensure proper file naming conventions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and application, followed by a written test or interview conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF, apply online links, and visit the official NEIGRIHMS website at https://www.neigrihms.gov.in for detailed updates.
